info.title: TorrentMate — the contract the maquette's interface requires
info.description:
WHAT THE NEXT VERSION OF THE FRONTEND NEEDS A SERVER TO ANSWER, declared by the interface rather than read off the backend that exists (D7 of docs/reference/frontend-architecture.md).

IT IS NOT frontend/openapi.json, which is generated FROM the running backend. The two differ on purpose and every difference is a DEMAND, computed by scripts/compare-contracts.py into docs/reference/frontend-backend-demands.md. No backend work happens until the interface is frozen; the register IS the future specification, delivered as a diff rather than a blank page.

SOME FIELDS ARE UGLY ON PURPOSE. Where a maquette fixture holds a pre-formatted string, this contract carries it verbatim rather than decomposing it into facts. That is D-L08-5, and it is what makes L09 provable: a mock returning exactly what the fixture returns renders the same thing, so the oracle proves the wiring at zero divergence. Every such field says so, and the demand register asks for the underlying fact.

x-seeded-from NAMES THE FIXTURE FAMILIES an operation's mock is seeded from. It is read by scripts/check-mock-seeds.py, so it is a contract and not a note.

x-unseeded IS THE OTHER HALF OF x-seeded-from, and every operation carries exactly one of the two. An operation whose response no fixture covers — an acknowledgement, a count derived from the request, a state token from this contract's own enum — says so in as many words. Without it, « nothing was invented here » and « nobody looked » are the same silence, and scripts/check-mock-seeds.py --arm provenance refuses an operation carrying neither.

MediaSheet.description: One media sheet. Every field's type below was MEASURED across the 326 sheets the fixture holds, not assumed: `runtime` is an integer count of minutes and was written as a string, `tmdbTelevisionId` is a string on the eleven sheets that carry it and was written as an integer, and `trailer` is a title rather than an object. The schema arm of `scripts/check-mock-seeds.py` found all three.
